# Overview

This document processes iButton skin temperature data (ankle and neck sensors) for all participants across all laboratory sessions.

**Expected Output Dataset:** ibuttons with columns: - id: Participant ID (P01-P10, excluding P08 and P11) - timestamp: Date-time in format YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS - session: Session identifier (C01_01 = Group 1, Evening 1) - ankle: Skin temperature at ankle (°C) - neck: Skin temperature at neck (°C) - DPG: Distal-Proximal Gradient (ankle - neck, °C)

**Data Processing:** First single files (2 per person per evening) will be merged into one dataset, which will then be used for the subsequent analyses.

**Missing Data:** For session 01 for participant P01 the sampling rate of the iButton sensor on the neck was set to a sampling interval of 1h instead of 1m, therefore data is missing for P01 session 01. Furthermore due to issues with the iButtons software there is missing data for subject P05 for the last experimental session.

## Processing Function

```{r processing-function}
#| eval: !expr '!file_exists'

# Function to prepare iButton data with error handling
prepare_ibutton <- function(file_path, session, participant, position, session_times_df) {
  
  # Check if file exists
  if (!file.exists(file_path)) {
    cat("Warning: File does not exist:", file_path, "- Returning NA data\n")
    
    # Create a minimal dataset with NA values
    na_df <- data.frame(
      timestamp = "01.01.2000 00:00",
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    na_df[[position]] <- NA_real_
    return(na_df)
  }
  
  # Extract session-specific start/end times
  times <- session_times_df %>% filter(session == !!session)
  start_time <- times$start_time
  end_time   <- times$end_time
  
  # Read Excel and process
  tryCatch({
    df <- read_excel(file_path, skip = 24) %>%
      mutate(
        Date = trimws(Date),
        Time = trimws(Time),
        datetime_full = parse_date_time(paste(Date, Time), orders = c("ymd HMS", "ymd HM")),
        datetime = round_date(datetime_full, unit = "minute"),
        datetime_formatted = format(datetime, "%d.%m.%Y %H:%M")
      ) %>%
      select(-datetime_full) %>%
      rename(timestamp = datetime_formatted) %>%
      select(timestamp, everything(), -Date, -Time, -datetime) %>%
      rename(!!paste0(position) := Value) %>%
      slice(-n()) %>%   
      mutate(
        timestamp_dt = dmy_hm(timestamp),
        time_only = format(timestamp_dt, "%H:%M")
      ) %>%
      filter(time_only >= start_time & time_only <= end_time) %>%
      select(-timestamp_dt, -time_only)
    
    return(df)
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Error reading file:", file_path, "- Error:", e$message, "- Returning NA data\n")
    
    # Create a minimal dataset with NA values
    na_df <- data.frame(
      timestamp = "01.01.2000 00:00",
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    na_df[[position]] <- NA_real_
    return(na_df)
  })
}
```

## Helper Functions

```{r helper-functions}
#| eval: !expr '!file_exists'

# Function to get session times for participant
get_session_times <- function(participant) {
  switch(participant,
         "P01" = P01_session_times,
         "P02" = P02_session_times,
         "P03" = P03_session_times,
         "P04" = P04_session_times,
         "P05" = P05_session_times,
         "P06" = P06_session_times,
         "P07" = P07_session_times,
         "P09" = P09_session_times,
         "P10" = P10_session_times,
         stop("Unknown participant: ", participant)
  )
}

# Function to get sessions for participant (different for each group)
get_sessions <- function(participant) {
  if (participant %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03")) {
    return(sessions_group1)  # 101:111 (11 sessions)
  } else if (participant %in% c("P04", "P05")) {
    return(sessions_group2)  # 101:110 (10 sessions)  
  } else if (participant %in% c("P06", "P07", "P09")) {
    return(sessions_group3)  # 101:110 (10 sessions)
  } else if (participant == "P10") {
    return(sessions_group4)  # 101:113 (13 sessions)
  } else {
    stop("Unknown participant: ", participant)
  }
}

# Function to get file paths for participant and position
get_file_paths <- function(participant, position) {
  path_name <- paste0(tolower(position), "_paths_", participant)
  switch(path_name,
         "ankle_paths_P01" = ankle_paths_P01,
         "neck_paths_P01" = neck_paths_P01,
         "ankle_paths_P02" = ankle_paths_P02,
         "neck_paths_P02" = neck_paths_P02,
         "ankle_paths_P03" = ankle_paths_P03,
         "neck_paths_P03" = neck_paths_P03,
         "ankle_paths_P04" = ankle_paths_P04,
         "neck_paths_P04" = neck_paths_P04,
         "ankle_paths_P05" = ankle_paths_P05,
         "neck_paths_P05" = neck_paths_P05,
         "ankle_paths_P06" = ankle_paths_P06,
         "neck_paths_P06" = neck_paths_P06,
         "ankle_paths_P07" = ankle_paths_P07,
         "neck_paths_P07" = neck_paths_P07,
         "ankle_paths_P09" = ankle_paths_P09,
         "neck_paths_P09" = neck_paths_P09,
         "ankle_paths_P10" = ankle_paths_P10,
         "neck_paths_P10" = neck_paths_P10,
         stop("Unknown path combination: ", path_name)
  )
}

# Function: Convert session number to CXX_YY format based on participant
convert_session_format <- function(session_num, participant) {
  session_int <- as.numeric(session_num) - 100
  
  # Determine group based on participant
  if (participant %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03")) {
    return(paste0("C01_", sprintf("%02d", session_int)))
  } else if (participant %in% c("P04", "P05")) {
    return(paste0("C02_", sprintf("%02d", session_int)))
  } else if (participant %in% c("P06", "P07", "P09")) {
    return(paste0("C03_", sprintf("%02d", session_int)))
  } else if (participant == "P10") {
    return(paste0("C04_", sprintf("%02d", session_int)))
  } else {
    stop("Unknown participant group for: ", participant)
  }
}
```

## Process All Participants

```{r process-participants}
#| eval: !expr '!file_exists'

# Initialize storage
all_participants_data <- list()

# Process all participants
for (participant in c("P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P09", "P10")) {
  
  cat("\n=== Processing participant:", participant, "===\n")
  
  # Get session times and sessions for current participant
  session_times <- get_session_times(participant)
  participant_sessions <- get_sessions(participant)
  
  # Initialize list for current participant
  participant_skin <- list()
  
  # Process all sessions for current participant
  for (i in seq_along(participant_sessions)) {
    session <- participant_sessions[i]
    
    # Get file paths
    ankle_paths <- get_file_paths(participant, "ankle")
    neck_paths <- get_file_paths(participant, "neck")
    
    # Prepare ankle
    ankle_df <- prepare_ibutton(
      file_path = ankle_paths[i],
      session = session,
      participant = participant,
      position = "ankle",
      session_times_df = session_times
    )
    
    # Prepare neck
    neck_df <- prepare_ibutton(
      file_path = neck_paths[i],
      session = session,
      participant = participant,
      position = "neck",
      session_times_df = session_times
    )
    
    # Merge ankle + neck (handle case where both might be NA datasets)
    if (nrow(ankle_df) == 1 && nrow(neck_df) == 1 && 
        ankle_df$timestamp[1] == "01.01.2000 00:00" && 
        neck_df$timestamp[1] == "01.01.2000 00:00") {
      # Both files missing - create combined NA dataset
      participant_skin[[session]] <- data.frame(
        timestamp = "01.01.2000 00:00",
        ankle = NA_real_,
        neck = NA_real_,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      cat("  Session", session, "- Both files missing, created NA dataset\n")
    } else {
      # At least one file exists - merge normally
      participant_skin[[session]] <- full_join(ankle_df, neck_df, by = "timestamp")
      cat("  Session", session, "processed:", nrow(participant_skin[[session]]), "rows\n")
    }
  }
  
  # Store participant data
  all_participants_data[[participant]] <- participant_skin
}
```

## Format and Merge Data

```{r format-merge}
#| eval: !expr '!file_exists'

# Initialize final data list
ibuttons_list <- list()

# Loop through all participants and sessions
for (participant in names(all_participants_data)) {
  participant_data <- all_participants_data[[participant]]
  
  cat("\n=== Processing participant:", participant, "===\n")
  
  # Loop through all sessions for current participant
  for (session in names(participant_data)) {
    
    # Current dataset
    current_data <- participant_data[[session]]
    
    # Skip empty datasets
    if (nrow(current_data) == 0) {
      cat("Warning: Participant", participant, "Session", session, "is empty. Skipping...\n")
      next
    }
    
    # Format final dataset
    formatted_data <- current_data %>%
      mutate(
        # Add ID
        id = participant,
        
        # Convert session format based on participant group
        session = convert_session_format(session, participant),
        
        # Convert timestamp to YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS format
        timestamp_dt = dmy_hm(timestamp),
        timestamp = format(timestamp_dt, "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S"),
        
        # Ensure ankle and neck are numeric (convert character NAs to numeric NAs)
        ankle = as.numeric(ankle),
        neck = as.numeric(neck)
      ) %>%
      # Select columns and arrange in desired order
      select(id, timestamp, session, ankle, neck) %>%
      # Remove rows where timestamp conversion failed (but keep NA data rows)
      filter(!is.na(timestamp) | (is.na(ankle) & is.na(neck)))
    
    # Create unique identifier for list
    list_key <- paste(participant, session, sep = "_")
    ibuttons_list[[list_key]] <- formatted_data
    
    cat("Participant", participant, "Session", session, "processed:", nrow(formatted_data), "rows\n")
  }
}

# Merge all sessions and participants into a single dataset
ibuttons <- bind_rows(ibuttons_list)
```

## Calculate DPG

```{r calculate-dpg}
#| eval: !expr '!file_exists'

# Calculate temperature gradient: Distal-Proximal Gradient (DPG)
# DPG = ankle - neck
# If either ankle or neck is NA, gradient will be NA
ibuttons <- ibuttons %>%
  mutate(
    DPG = ankle - neck
  )
```

# Save Dataset

```{r save-dataset}
#| eval: !expr '!file_exists'

# Create output directory if it doesn't exist
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  cat("Created directory:", output_dir, "\n")
}

# Convert entire dataset to character to preserve NAs as "NA" text
ibuttons_for_excel <- ibuttons %>%

  )

# Write to Excel
```

# Calculate Rate of Change (ROC) for iButton data

Following a similar (slightly different) approach as van Marken Lichtenbelt et al. (2006) cleaning procedure

Step 1: Rate of Change (ROC) Detection: The rate of change (ROC) was calculated for each consecutive temperature measurement within each participant and session Session-specific interquartile ranges (IQR) were computed based on the 25th and 75th percentiles of ROC values Temperature changes exceeding 1.5 × IQR were flagged as artifacts, indicating sudden, implausible fluctuations

Step 2: Level-Based Outlier Detection: Absolute temperature values were evaluated using session-specific IQRs (25th and 75th percentiles) Values falling outside the range \[Q1 - 1.5×IQR, Q3 + 1.5×IQR\] were flagged as outliers

Step 3: Artifact Removal: If either Step 1 (ROC-based) or Step 2 (level-based) flagged a measurement as an artifact, the corresponding ankle and neck temperature values were set to NA Distal-proximal gradient (DPG) values were recalculated after artifact removal, with DPG set to NA if either ankle or neck temperature was missing

```{r calculate-roc}
# Calculate ROC separately for each participant, session, and measurement site
ibuttons <- ibuttons %>%
  group_by(id, session) %>%
  arrange(id, session, timestamp) %>%
  mutate(
    # ROC for ankle (change per minute)
    roc_ankle = ankle - lag(ankle),
    
    # ROC for neck (change per minute)
    roc_neck = neck - lag(neck)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

# ROC by Participant and Session

```{r roc-by-session}
# Summary by participant and session
roc_summary <- ibuttons %>%
  group_by(id, session) %>%
  summarise(
    ankle_mean_roc = mean(abs(roc_ankle), na.rm = TRUE),
    ankle_max_roc = max(abs(roc_ankle), na.rm = TRUE),
    neck_mean_roc = mean(abs(roc_neck), na.rm = TRUE),
    neck_max_roc = max(abs(roc_neck), na.rm = TRUE),
    n_obs = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(roc_summary)
```

# Step 1: ROC-based Outlier Detection (adapted for laboratory conditions)

Approach: Using 1.5×IQR instead of 1×IQR (van Marken Lichtenbelt et al. 2006 used 1×IQR for field studies)

```{r step1-roc-outliers}
# Calculate thresholds per participant and session (1.5×IQR for lab conditions)
roc_thresholds <- ibuttons %>%
  group_by(id, session) %>%
  summarise(
    ankle_lower = quantile(roc_ankle, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE) - 1.5 * IQR(roc_ankle, na.rm = TRUE),
    ankle_upper = quantile(roc_ankle, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) + 1.5 * IQR(roc_ankle, na.rm = TRUE),
    neck_lower = quantile(roc_neck, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE) - 1.5 * IQR(roc_neck, na.rm = TRUE),
    neck_upper = quantile(roc_neck, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) + 1.5 * IQR(roc_neck, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Flag outliers
ibuttons <- ibuttons %>%
  left_join(roc_thresholds, by = c("id", "session")) %>%
  mutate(
    outlier_roc_ankle = roc_ankle < ankle_lower | roc_ankle > ankle_upper,
    outlier_roc_neck = roc_neck < neck_lower | roc_neck > neck_upper
  ) %>%
  select(-ends_with("_lower"), -ends_with("_upper"))  # GEÄNDERT

cat("ROC outliers - Ankle:", sum(ibuttons$outlier_roc_ankle, na.rm = TRUE), "/", sum(!is.na(ibuttons$outlier_roc_ankle)), "\n")
cat("ROC outliers - Neck:", sum(ibuttons$outlier_roc_neck, na.rm = TRUE), "/", sum(!is.na(ibuttons$outlier_roc_neck)), "\n")
```

# Step 2: Level-based Outlier Detection

```{r step2-level-outliers}
# Calculate thresholds for absolute temperature values (1.5×IQR for lab conditions)
level_thresholds <- ibuttons %>%
  group_by(id, session) %>%
  summarise(
    ankle_lower = quantile(ankle, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE) - 1.5 * IQR(ankle, na.rm = TRUE),
    ankle_upper = quantile(ankle, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) + 1.5 * IQR(ankle, na.rm = TRUE),
    neck_lower = quantile(neck, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE) - 1.5 * IQR(neck, na.rm = TRUE),
    neck_upper = quantile(neck, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) + 1.5 * IQR(neck, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Flag level-based outliers
ibuttons <- ibuttons %>%
  left_join(level_thresholds, by = c("id", "session")) %>%
  mutate(
    outlier_level_ankle = ankle < ankle_lower | ankle > ankle_upper,
    outlier_level_neck = neck < neck_lower | neck > neck_upper
  ) %>%
  select(-ends_with("_lower"), -ends_with("_upper"))  # GEÄNDERT

cat("Level outliers - Ankle:", sum(ibuttons$outlier_level_ankle, na.rm = TRUE), "/", sum(!is.na(ibuttons$outlier_level_ankle)), "\n")
cat("Level outliers - Neck:", sum(ibuttons$outlier_level_neck, na.rm = TRUE), "/", sum(!is.na(ibuttons$outlier_level_neck)), "\n")
```

# Combine outlier flags

```{r combine-outliers}
ibuttons <- ibuttons %>%
  mutate(
    outlier_ankle = outlier_roc_ankle | outlier_level_ankle,
    outlier_neck = outlier_roc_neck | outlier_level_neck
  )

# Final summary
cat("=== Final Outlier Summary ===\n")
cat("Ankle:", sum(ibuttons$outlier_ankle, na.rm = TRUE), 
    "/", sum(!is.na(ibuttons$outlier_ankle)), 
    "(", round(100 * sum(ibuttons$outlier_ankle, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(!is.na(ibuttons$outlier_ankle)), 1), "%)\n")
cat("Neck:", sum(ibuttons$outlier_neck, na.rm = TRUE), 
    "/", sum(!is.na(ibuttons$outlier_neck)), 
    "(", round(100 * sum(ibuttons$outlier_neck, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(!is.na(ibuttons$outlier_neck)), 1), "%)\n")
```

# Calculate 30-minute block means for DPG

```{r calculate-dpg-30min-blocks}
ibuttons <- ibuttons %>%
  mutate(
    time = paste0(substr(timestamp, 10, 11), ":", substr(timestamp, 12, 13)),
    group = case_when(
      id %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03") ~ 1,
      id %in% c("P04", "P05") ~ 2,
      id %in% c("P06", "P07", "P09") ~ 3,
      id %in% c("P10") ~ 4
    ),
    # Assign time blocks based on group
    time_block = case_when(
      # Group 1: 18:30-23:30
      group == 1 & time >= "18:30" & time < "19:00" ~ "18:30-19:00",
      group == 1 & time >= "19:00" & time < "19:30" ~ "19:00-19:30",
      group == 1 & time >= "19:30" & time < "20:00" ~ "19:30-20:00",
      group == 1 & time >= "20:00" & time < "20:30" ~ "20:00-20:30",
      group == 1 & time >= "20:30" & time < "21:00" ~ "20:30-21:00",
      group == 1 & time >= "21:00" & time < "21:30" ~ "21:00-21:30",
      group == 1 & time >= "21:30" & time < "22:00" ~ "21:30-22:00",
      group == 1 & time >= "22:00" & time < "22:30" ~ "22:00-22:30",
      group == 1 & time >= "22:30" & time < "23:00" ~ "22:30-23:00",
      group == 1 & time >= "23:00" & time <= "23:30" ~ "23:00-23:30",
      
      # Group 2: 16:30-21:30
      group == 2 & time >= "16:30" & time < "17:00" ~ "16:30-17:00",
      group == 2 & time >= "17:00" & time < "17:30" ~ "17:00-17:30",
      group == 2 & time >= "17:30" & time < "18:00" ~ "17:30-18:00",
      group == 2 & time >= "18:00" & time < "18:30" ~ "18:00-18:30",
      group == 2 & time >= "18:30" & time < "19:00" ~ "18:30-19:00",
      group == 2 & time >= "19:00" & time < "19:30" ~ "19:00-19:30",
      group == 2 & time >= "19:30" & time < "20:00" ~ "19:30-20:00",
      group == 2 & time >= "20:00" & time < "20:30" ~ "20:00-20:30",
      group == 2 & time >= "20:30" & time < "21:00" ~ "20:30-21:00",
      group == 2 & time >= "21:00" & time <= "21:30" ~ "21:00-21:30",
      
      # Group 3: 18:00-23:00
      group == 3 & time >= "18:00" & time < "18:30" ~ "18:00-18:30",
      group == 3 & time >= "18:30" & time < "19:00" ~ "18:30-19:00",
      group == 3 & time >= "19:00" & time < "19:30" ~ "19:00-19:30",
      group == 3 & time >= "19:30" & time < "20:00" ~ "19:30-20:00",
      group == 3 & time >= "20:00" & time < "20:30" ~ "20:00-20:30",
      group == 3 & time >= "20:30" & time < "21:00" ~ "20:30-21:00",
      group == 3 & time >= "21:00" & time < "21:30" ~ "21:00-21:30",
      group == 3 & time >= "21:30" & time < "22:00" ~ "21:30-22:00",
      group == 3 & time >= "22:00" & time < "22:30" ~ "22:00-22:30",
      group == 3 & time >= "22:30" & time <= "23:00" ~ "22:30-23:00",
      
      # Group 4: 17:30-22:30
      group == 4 & time >= "17:30" & time < "18:00" ~ "17:30-18:00",
      group == 4 & time >= "18:00" & time < "18:30" ~ "18:00-18:30",
      group == 4 & time >= "18:30" & time < "19:00" ~ "18:30-19:00",
      group == 4 & time >= "19:00" & time < "19:30" ~ "19:00-19:30",
      group == 4 & time >= "19:30" & time < "20:00" ~ "19:30-20:00",
      group == 4 & time >= "20:00" & time < "20:30" ~ "20:00-20:30",
      group == 4 & time >= "20:30" & time < "21:00" ~ "20:30-21:00",
      group == 4 & time >= "21:00" & time < "21:30" ~ "21:00-21:30",
      group == 4 & time >= "21:30" & time < "22:00" ~ "21:30-22:00",
      group == 4 & time >= "22:00" & time <= "22:30" ~ "22:00-22:30",
      
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(id, session, time_block) %>%
  mutate(DPG_30min = mean(DPG, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r dpg-visualization-setup}
#| label: dpg-visualization-setup

# Define participant information for light exposure patterns
participant_info <- list(
  P01 = list(hbt = 0, light_pattern = c("D", "D", "D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"), group = 1),
  P02 = list(hbt = 0, light_pattern = c("D", "D", "D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"), group = 1),
  P03 = list(hbt = 0, light_pattern = c("D", "D", "D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"), group = 1),
  P04 = list(hbt = 22, light_pattern = c("D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"), group = 2),
  P05 = list(hbt = 22, light_pattern = c("D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"), group = 2),
  P06 = list(hbt = 23.5, light_pattern = c("D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"), group = 3),
  P07 = list(hbt = 23.5, light_pattern = c("D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"), group = 3),
  P09 = list(hbt = 23.5, light_pattern = c("D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"), group = 3),
  P10 = list(hbt = 23, light_pattern = c("D", "D", "D", "B", NA, "D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "B", "D", "D"), group = 4)
)

# Function to create DPG plot for one participant
create_dpg_plot <- function(participant_id, info) {
  
  # Prepare data
  dpg_plot <- ibuttons %>%
    filter(id == participant_id) %>%
    filter(!(participant_id == "P10" & session == "C04_05")) %>%
    mutate(
      session_num = as.numeric(gsub("C0[1-4]_", "", session))
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      light_condition = info$light_pattern[session_num]
    ) %>%
    group_by(session_num, time_block) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      start_hour = as.numeric(substr(time_block, 1, 2)),
      start_min = as.numeric(substr(time_block, 4, 5)),
      time_decimal_mid = start_hour + start_min/60 + 0.25,
      hours_before_hbt = case_when(
        info$hbt == 0 ~ 24 - time_decimal_mid,
        info$hbt == 22 ~ ifelse(time_decimal_mid >= 16.5, 22 - time_decimal_mid, NA_real_),
        info$hbt == 23 ~ ifelse(time_decimal_mid >= 17.5, 23 - time_decimal_mid, NA_real_),
        info$hbt == 23.5 ~ ifelse(time_decimal_mid >= 18, 23.5 - time_decimal_mid, NA_real_),
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(hours_before_hbt >= 0.5 & hours_before_hbt <= 5.5) %>%
    arrange(session_num, hours_before_hbt)
  
  if(nrow(dpg_plot) == 0) {
    warning(paste("No data available for", participant_id))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Determine y-axis limits
  y_min <- floor(min(dpg_plot$DPG_30min, na.rm = TRUE) * 10) / 10 - 0.1
  y_max <- ceiling(max(dpg_plot$DPG_30min, na.rm = TRUE) * 10) / 10 + 0.1
  
  # X-axis labels with HBT times (odd blocks only)
  x_labels <- c(
    "B1\n(5.25h)", "B2", "B3\n(4.25h)", "B4", "B5\n(3.25h)",
    "B6", "B7\n(2.25h)", "B8", "B9\n(1.25h)", "B10"
  )
  
  # Create plot
  p <- ggplot(dpg_plot, aes(x = hours_before_hbt, y = DPG_30min)) +
    
    # Only yellow background for B evenings, no background for D evenings
    geom_rect(data = subset(dpg_plot, light_condition == "B") %>%
                group_by(session_num) %>% slice(1) %>% ungroup(),
              aes(xmin = 2.5, xmax = 1, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
              fill = "#FFF9E6", alpha = 0.8, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    
    geom_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(color = "black", size = 2.5) +
    
    scale_x_reverse(
      breaks = c(5.25, 4.75, 4.25, 3.75, 3.25, 2.75, 2.25, 1.75, 1.25, 0.75),
      labels = x_labels,
      limits = c(5.5, 0.5),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(y_min, y_max),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05))
    ) +
    
    facet_wrap(~ session_num, ncol = 4,
               labeller = labeller(session_num = function(x) {
                 sapply(x, function(session) {
                   session_num <- as.numeric(session)
                   light_label <- if(session_num <= length(info$light_pattern) &&
                                    !is.na(info$light_pattern[session_num])) {
                     info$light_pattern[session_num]
                   } else {
                     "?"
                   }
                   paste0("Evening ", session, " (", light_label, ")")
                 })
               })) +
    
    labs(
      title = paste0("Distal-proximal skin temperature gradient per evening (", participant_id, ")"),
      x = "Block number (hours before HBT)",
      y = "DPG [°C]"
    ) +
    
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      aspect.ratio = 1,
      plot.title = element_text(size = 15, hjust = 0, face = "plain", margin = margin(b = 10)),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.5),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.5),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  
  return(p)
}
```

# Calculate DPG_entire and DPG_intervention from cleaned minute-level DPG values

DPG_entire = mean of DPG values for entire 5h spent in the controlled climate chamber DPG_intervention = mean of DPG values for light intervention time window

```{r dpg-calculate-windows-from-raw}
ibuttons <- ibuttons %>%
  mutate(
    time = paste0(substr(timestamp, 10, 11), ":", substr(timestamp, 12, 13)),
    
    # Calculate hours before HBT per group
    start_hour = as.numeric(substr(timestamp, 10, 11)),
    start_min = as.numeric(substr(timestamp, 12, 13)),
    time_decimal = start_hour + start_min/60,
    
    hours_before_hbt = case_when(
      # Group 1: HBT = 00:00 (midnight)
      group == 1 ~ 24 - time_decimal,
      # Group 2: HBT = 22:00
      group == 2 ~ ifelse(time_decimal >= 16.5, 22 - time_decimal, NA_real_),
      # Group 3: HBT = 23:30
      group == 3 ~ ifelse(time_decimal >= 18, 23.5 - time_decimal, NA_real_),
      # Group 4: HBT = 23:00
      group == 4 ~ ifelse(time_decimal >= 17.5, 23 - time_decimal, NA_real_),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    # Define windows based on hours before HBT
    in_entire_window = (hours_before_hbt >= 0.5 & hours_before_hbt <= 5.5),
    in_intervention_window = (hours_before_hbt >= 1.0 & hours_before_hbt <= 2.5)
  ) %>%
  # Calculate means per session from minute-level DPG values 
  group_by(id, session) %>%
  mutate(
    DPG_entire = mean(DPG[in_entire_window], na.rm = TRUE),
    DPG_intervention = mean(DPG[in_intervention_window], na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Remove helper variables
  select(-start_hour, -start_min, -time_decimal, -hours_before_hbt, 
         -in_entire_window, -in_intervention_window)
```

```{r dpg-windows-table-from-raw}
  ) %>%
```

```{r}
  P06 = strsplit("DBBBDDDBDB", "")[[1]],
  P09 = strsplit("DBBBDDDBDB", "")[[1]],
  P10 = strsplit("DDDBXDBBBDBDD", "")[[1]]
)

# Add light condition to data
dpg_data <- ibuttons %>%
  filter(id != "P07") %>%
  mutate(
    session_num = as.numeric(sub("C\\d+_(\\d+)", "\\1", session)),
    light_condition = sapply(1:n(), function(i) light_patterns[[id[i]]][session_num[i]])
  )

# Aggregate to session level first
dpg_sessions <- dpg_data %>%
  filter(light_condition != "X") %>%  # Exclude P10 session 5
  group_by(id, session, light_condition) %>%
  slice(1) %>%  # Take one row per session
  ungroup()

# Calculate mean ± SD by light condition
dpg_summary <- dpg_sessions %>%
  group_by(light_condition) %>%
  summarise(
    DPG_entire = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f", 
                         mean(DPG_entire, na.rm = TRUE), 
                         sd(DPG_entire, na.rm = TRUE)),
    DPG_intervention = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f", 
                               mean(DPG_intervention, na.rm = TRUE), 
                               sd(DPG_intervention, na.rm = TRUE)),
    n_sessions = n()
  )

print(dpg_summary)
```

# DPG Doublet Analysis - 5h Exposure Window

```{r dpg-doublet-setup}
# Define light patterns for groups to make sure they are available
light_g1 <- unlist(strsplit("DDDBBBDDBDB", ""))
light_g2 <- unlist(strsplit("DBBBDDDBDB", ""))
light_g4_orig <- unlist(strsplit("DDDBXDBBBDBDD", ""))

# Create doublet dataframes
df_doublets_g1 <- data.frame(
  session_start = 1:(length(light_g1) - 1),
  session_end = 2:length(light_g1),
  doublet = paste0(light_g1[-length(light_g1)], light_g1[-1])
)

df_doublets_g2 <- data.frame(
  session_start = 1:(length(light_g2) - 1),
  session_end = 2:length(light_g2),
  doublet = paste0(light_g2[-length(light_g2)], light_g2[-1])
)

df_doublets_g4_orig <- data.frame(
  session_start = 1:(length(light_g4_orig) - 1),
  session_end = 2:length(light_g4_orig),
  doublet = paste0(light_g4_orig[-length(light_g4_orig)], light_g4_orig[-1])
)

# Filter out doublets containing X (excluded session)
df_doublets_g4 <- df_doublets_g4_orig %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(doublet, "X"))
```

```{r dpg-doublet-calculate-5h}
# Calculate doublet DPG for all participants - entire 5h window
participants <- c("P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P09", "P10")
doublets <- c("DD", "DB", "BD", "BB")

df_plot_dpg <- data.frame(
  doublet = character(),
  participant = character(),
  mean_dpg = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for(p in participants) {
  # Select appropriate doublet mapping
  if(p %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03")) {
    df_doublets <- df_doublets_g1
  } else if(p %in% c("P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P09")) {
    df_doublets <- df_doublets_g2
  } else {
    df_doublets <- df_doublets_g4
  }
  
  # Get DPG data (one row per session with DPG_entire)
  dpg_data <- ibuttons %>%
    filter(id == p) %>%
    # Exclude P10 session 5
    filter(!(p == "P10" & session == "C04_05")) %>%
    group_by(session) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(exp_session = as.numeric(gsub("C0[1-4]_", "", session))) %>%
    select(exp_session, DPG_entire)
  
  # Join with doublets
  dpg_doublets <- df_doublets %>%
    rename(exp_session = session_end) %>%
    left_join(dpg_data, by = "exp_session")
  
  # Calculate mean per doublet
  mean_dpg_doublets <- dpg_doublets %>%
    group_by(doublet) %>%
    summarise(mean_dpg = mean(DPG_entire, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Add to plot data
  for(d in doublets) {
    if(d %in% mean_dpg_doublets$doublet) {
      df_plot_dpg <- rbind(df_plot_dpg, data.frame(
        doublet = d,
        participant = p,
        mean_dpg = mean_dpg_doublets$mean_dpg[mean_dpg_doublets$doublet == d]
      ))
    }
  }
}

df_plot_dpg$doublet <- factor(df_plot_dpg$doublet, levels = c("DD", "BD", "DB", "BB"))
```

```{r dpg-doublet-plot-5h}

  )
```

# DPG Doublet Position Analysis - 5h Exposure Window with Standard Error Bars

```{r dpg-doublet-position-setup}
# Create doublet position mappings
doublet_positions_g1 <- df_doublets_g1 %>%
  group_by(doublet) %>%
  summarise(
    position1_sessions = list(session_start),
    position2_sessions = list(session_end),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

doublet_positions_g2 <- df_doublets_g2 %>%
  group_by(doublet) %>%
  summarise(
    position1_sessions = list(session_start),
    position2_sessions = list(session_end),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

doublet_positions_g4 <- df_doublets_g4 %>%
  group_by(doublet) %>%
  summarise(
    position1_sessions = list(session_start),
    position2_sessions = list(session_end),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Function to calculate doublet positions for DPG (entire window)
calc_doublet_positions_dpg <- function(participant_id, dpg_data, doublet_map) {
  results <- doublet_map %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      pos1_dpg = mean(dpg_data$DPG_entire[dpg_data$exp_session %in% position1_sessions], 
                      na.rm = TRUE),
      pos2_dpg = mean(dpg_data$DPG_entire[dpg_data$exp_session %in% position2_sessions], 
                      na.rm = TRUE),
      participant = participant_id
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(participant, doublet, pos1_dpg, pos2_dpg)
  
  return(results)
}
```

```{r dpg-doublet-position-calculate-5h}
# Calculate position data for all participants (excluding P07) - 5h window
participants_noP07 <- c("P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P09", "P10")
doublets <- c("DD", "DB", "BD", "BB")

mean_doublet_pos_dpg_noP07 <- data.frame(
  doublet = character(),
  position = character(),
  mean_dpg = numeric(),
  sd_dpg = numeric(),
  se_dpg = numeric(),
  n_participants = integer(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for(d in doublets) {
  for(pos in c("pos1", "pos2")) {
    values <- c()
    for(p in participants_noP07) {
      # Select mapping
      if(p %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03")) {
        doublet_map <- doublet_positions_g1
      } else if(p %in% c("P04", "P05", "P06", "P09")) {
        doublet_map <- doublet_positions_g2
      } else {
        doublet_map <- doublet_positions_g4
      }
      
      # Get DPG data
      dpg_data <- ibuttons %>%
        filter(id == p) %>%
        filter(!(p == "P10" & session == "C04_05")) %>%
        group_by(session) %>%
        slice(1) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        mutate(exp_session = as.numeric(gsub("C0[1-4]_", "", session))) %>%
        select(exp_session, DPG_entire)
      
      # Calculate positions
      pos_dpg <- calc_doublet_positions_dpg(p, dpg_data, doublet_map)
      
      # Extract value
      if(d %in% pos_dpg$doublet) {
        if(pos == "pos1") {
          values <- c(values, pos_dpg$pos1_dpg[pos_dpg$doublet == d])
        } else {
          values <- c(values, pos_dpg$pos2_dpg[pos_dpg$doublet == d])
        }
      }
    }
    
    if(length(values) > 0) {
      n <- length(values)
      mean_doublet_pos_dpg_noP07 <- rbind(mean_doublet_pos_dpg_noP07, data.frame(
        doublet = d,
        position = pos,
        mean_dpg = mean(values, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_dpg = sd(values, na.rm = TRUE),
        se_dpg = sd(values, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n),  # Standard Error
        n_participants = n
      ))
    }
  }
}

# Prepare for plotting
df_plot_positions_dpg_noP07 <- mean_doublet_pos_dpg_noP07 %>%
  mutate(
    position_label = ifelse(position == "pos1", "Position 1", "Position 2"),
    position_num = ifelse(position == "pos1", 1, 2),
    light_type = ifelse(position == "pos1", 
                        substr(doublet, 1, 1),
                        substr(doublet, 2, 2)),
    light_label = ifelse(light_type == "D", "dim", "bright")
  ) %>%
  mutate(doublet = factor(doublet, levels = c("DD", "BD", "DB", "BB")))
```

```{r dpg-doublet-position-with-error-panel}
# Define color scheme
light_colors <- c("dim" = "#4A90E2", "bright" = "#F5A623")

# Main plot without error bars
p_main <- ggplot(df_plot_positions_dpg_noP07, 
                 aes(x = position_num, y = mean_dpg, group = doublet)) +
  geom_line(color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(aes(color = light_label), size = 5, shape = 16) +
  scale_color_manual(values = light_colors,
                     labels = c("dim" = "Dim (10 lx)", "bright" = "Bright (1000 lx)")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 2), 
                     labels = c("Position 1", "Position 2"),
                     limits = c(0.8, 2.2)) +
  labs(
    title = "Distal-proximal gradient across light exposure doublets",
    subtitle = "Mean DPG across all participants (5-h exposure; P07 excluded)",
    x = "Doublet position",
    y = "Mean Distal-Proximal Gradient (°C)",
    color = "Light condition"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0),

    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 13),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# Error Bar Panel (right)
p_error <- ggplot(df_plot_positions_dpg_noP07, 
                  aes(x = doublet, y = mean_dpg, color = light_label)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_dpg - se_dpg, ymax = mean_dpg + se_dpg),
                width = 0.3, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 3, shape = 16) +

  theme(

    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9, angle = 0),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3)
  )

# Combine both plots
p_main + p_error + plot_layout(widths = c(3, 1))
```

```{r dpg-doublet-position-intervention-with-error-panel}
  labs(
    title = "Distal-proximal gradient across light exposure doublets",
    subtitle = "Mean DPG across all participants (1.5-h intervention window; P07 excluded)",
    x = "Doublet position",
    y = "Mean Distal-Proximal Gradient (°C)",
    color = "Light condition"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 10)),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 13),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# Error bar panel (right)
p_error_int <- ggplot(df_plot_positions_dpg_int_noP07, 
                      aes(x = doublet, y = mean_dpg_int, color = light_label)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_dpg_int - se_dpg_int, ymax = mean_dpg_int + se_dpg_int),
                width = 0.3, linewidth = 0.8) +

  )
```

# DPG Triplet Analysis - 5h Exposure Window

```{r dpg-triplet-setup}
# Define light patterns for triplets to make sure they are avialable 
light_g1 <- unlist(strsplit("DDDBBBDDBDB", ""))
light_g2 <- unlist(strsplit("DBBBDDDBDB", ""))
light_g4_orig <- unlist(strsplit("DDDBXDBBBDBDD", ""))

# Create triplet dataframes
df_triplets_g1 <- data.frame(
  session_start = 1:(length(light_g1) - 2),
  session_mid = 2:(length(light_g1) - 1),
  session_end = 3:length(light_g1),
  triplet = paste0(light_g1[1:(length(light_g1) - 2)], 
                   light_g1[2:(length(light_g1) - 1)], 
                   light_g1[3:length(light_g1)])
)

df_triplets_g2 <- data.frame(
  session_start = 1:(length(light_g2) - 2),
  session_mid = 2:(length(light_g2) - 1),
  session_end = 3:length(light_g2),
  triplet = paste0(light_g2[1:(length(light_g2) - 2)], 
                   light_g2[2:(length(light_g2) - 1)], 
                   light_g2[3:length(light_g2)])
)

df_triplets_g4_orig <- data.frame(
  session_start = 1:(length(light_g4_orig) - 2),
  session_mid = 2:(length(light_g4_orig) - 1),
  session_end = 3:length(light_g4_orig),
  triplet = paste0(light_g4_orig[1:(length(light_g4_orig) - 2)], 
                   light_g4_orig[2:(length(light_g4_orig) - 1)], 
                   light_g4_orig[3:length(light_g4_orig)])
)

# Filter out triplets containing X (excluded session 5 for P10)
df_triplets_g4 <- df_triplets_g4_orig %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(triplet, "X"))
```

```{r dpg-triplet-calculate-5h}
# Calculate triplet DPG for all participants - entire 5h window
participants <- c("P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P09", "P10")
triplets <- c("DDD", "DDB", "DBD", "DBB", "BDD", "BDB", "BBD", "BBB")

df_plot_dpg_triplet <- data.frame(
  triplet = character(),
  participant = character(),
  mean_dpg = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for(p in participants) {
  # Select appropriate triplet mapping
  if(p %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03")) {
    df_triplets <- df_triplets_g1
  } else if(p %in% c("P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P09")) {
    df_triplets <- df_triplets_g2
  } else {
    df_triplets <- df_triplets_g4
  }
  
  # Get DPG data
  dpg_data <- ibuttons %>%
    filter(id == p) %>%
    filter(!(p == "P10" & session == "C04_05")) %>%
    group_by(session) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(exp_session = as.numeric(gsub("C0[1-4]_", "", session))) %>%
    select(exp_session, DPG_entire)
  
  # Join with triplets
  dpg_triplets <- df_triplets %>%
    rename(exp_session = session_end) %>%
    left_join(dpg_data, by = "exp_session")
  
  # Calculate mean per triplet
  mean_dpg_triplets <- dpg_triplets %>%
    group_by(triplet) %>%
    summarise(mean_dpg = mean(DPG_entire, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Add to plot data
  for(t in triplets) {
    if(t %in% mean_dpg_triplets$triplet) {
      df_plot_dpg_triplet <- rbind(df_plot_dpg_triplet, data.frame(
        triplet = t,
        participant = p,
        mean_dpg = mean_dpg_triplets$mean_dpg[mean_dpg_triplets$triplet == t]
      ))
    }
  }
}

df_plot_dpg_triplet$triplet <- factor(df_plot_dpg_triplet$triplet, 
                                      levels = c("DDD", "BDD", "DBD", "BBD", 
                                                "DDB", "BDB", "DBB", "BBB"))
```

# DPG Triplet Position Analysis - 5h Exposure Window

```{r dpg-triplet-position-setup}
# Create triplet position mappings
triplet_positions_g1 <- df_triplets_g1 %>%
  group_by(triplet) %>%
  summarise(
    position1_sessions = list(session_start),
    position2_sessions = list(session_mid),
    position3_sessions = list(session_end),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

triplet_positions_g2 <- df_triplets_g2 %>%
  group_by(triplet) %>%
  summarise(
    position1_sessions = list(session_start),
    position2_sessions = list(session_mid),
    position3_sessions = list(session_end),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

triplet_positions_g4 <- df_triplets_g4 %>%
  group_by(triplet) %>%
  summarise(
    position1_sessions = list(session_start),
    position2_sessions = list(session_mid),
    position3_sessions = list(session_end),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Function to calculate triplet positions for DPG (entire window)
calc_triplet_positions_dpg <- function(participant_id, dpg_data, triplet_map) {
  results <- triplet_map %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      pos1_dpg = mean(dpg_data$DPG_entire[dpg_data$exp_session %in% position1_sessions], 
                      na.rm = TRUE),
      pos2_dpg = mean(dpg_data$DPG_entire[dpg_data$exp_session %in% position2_sessions], 
                      na.rm = TRUE),
      pos3_dpg = mean(dpg_data$DPG_entire[dpg_data$exp_session %in% position3_sessions], 
                      na.rm = TRUE),
      participant = participant_id
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(participant, triplet, pos1_dpg, pos2_dpg, pos3_dpg)
  
  return(results)
}

# Function for intervention window
calc_triplet_positions_dpg_int <- function(participant_id, dpg_data_int, triplet_map) {
  results <- triplet_map %>% 
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      pos1_dpg_int = mean(dpg_data_int$DPG_intervention[dpg_data_int$exp_session %in% position1_sessions], 
                          na.rm = TRUE),
      pos2_dpg_int = mean(dpg_data_int$DPG_intervention[dpg_data_int$exp_session %in% position2_sessions], 
                          na.rm = TRUE),
      pos3_dpg_int = mean(dpg_data_int$DPG_intervention[dpg_data_int$exp_session %in% position3_sessions], 
                          na.rm = TRUE),
      participant = participant_id
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(participant, triplet, pos1_dpg_int, pos2_dpg_int, pos3_dpg_int)
  
  return(results)
}
```

```{r dpg-triplet-position-calculate-5h}
# Calculate position data for all participants (excluding P07) - 5h window
participants_noP07 <- c("P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P09", "P10")
triplets <- c("DDD", "DDB", "DBD", "DBB", "BDD", "BDB", "BBD", "BBB")

mean_triplet_pos_dpg_noP07 <- data.frame(
  triplet = character(),
  position = character(),
  mean_dpg = numeric(),
  sd_dpg = numeric(),
  se_dpg = numeric(),
  n_participants = integer(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for(t in triplets) {
  for(pos in c("pos1", "pos2", "pos3")) {
    values <- c()
    for(p in participants_noP07) {
      # Select mapping
      if(p %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03")) {
        triplet_map <- triplet_positions_g1
      } else if(p %in% c("P04", "P05", "P06", "P09")) {
        triplet_map <- triplet_positions_g2
      } else {
        triplet_map <- triplet_positions_g4
      }
      
      # Get DPG data
      dpg_data <- ibuttons %>%
        filter(id == p) %>%
        filter(!(p == "P10" & session == "C04_05")) %>%
        group_by(session) %>%
        slice(1) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        mutate(exp_session = as.numeric(gsub("C0[1-4]_", "", session))) %>%
        select(exp_session, DPG_entire)
      
      # Calculate positions
      pos_dpg <- calc_triplet_positions_dpg(p, dpg_data, triplet_map)
      
      # Extract value
      if(t %in% pos_dpg$triplet) {
        if(pos == "pos1") {
          values <- c(values, pos_dpg$pos1_dpg[pos_dpg$triplet == t])
        } else if(pos == "pos2") {
          values <- c(values, pos_dpg$pos2_dpg[pos_dpg$triplet == t])
        } else {
          values <- c(values, pos_dpg$pos3_dpg[pos_dpg$triplet == t])
        }
      }
    }
    
    if(length(values) > 0) {
      n <- length(values)
      mean_triplet_pos_dpg_noP07 <- rbind(mean_triplet_pos_dpg_noP07, data.frame(
        triplet = t,
        position = pos,
        mean_dpg = mean(values, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_dpg = sd(values, na.rm = TRUE),
        se_dpg = sd(values, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n),
        n_participants = n
      ))
    }
  }
}

# Prepare for plotting
df_plot_positions_triplet_dpg_noP07 <- mean_triplet_pos_dpg_noP07 %>%
  mutate(
    position_label = case_when(
      position == "pos1" ~ "Position 1",
      position == "pos2" ~ "Position 2",
      position == "pos3" ~ "Position 3"
    ),
    position_num = case_when(
      position == "pos1" ~ 1,
      position == "pos2" ~ 2,
      position == "pos3" ~ 3
    ),
    light_type = case_when(
      position == "pos1" ~ substr(triplet, 1, 1),
      position == "pos2" ~ substr(triplet, 2, 2),
      position == "pos3" ~ substr(triplet, 3, 3)
    ),
    light_label = ifelse(light_type == "D", "dim", "bright")
  ) %>%
  mutate(triplet = factor(triplet, levels = c("DDD", "BDD", "DBD", "BBD", 
                                              "DDB", "BDB", "DBB", "BBB")))
```

```{r dpg-triplet-position-plot-5h-with-error-panel}
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3)
  )

# Combine both plots
p_main_triplet + p_error_triplet + plot_layout(widths = c(3, 1))
```

```{r dpg-triplet-position-calculate-intervention}
# Calculate position data for intervention window (excluding P07) - 1.5h window
participants_int <- c("P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P09", "P10")

mean_triplet_pos_dpg_int_noP07 <- data.frame(
  triplet = character(),
  position = character(),
  mean_dpg_int = numeric(),
  sd_dpg_int = numeric(),
  se_dpg_int = numeric(),
  n_participants = integer(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for(t in triplets) {
  for(pos in c("pos1", "pos2", "pos3")) {
    values <- c()
    for(p in participants_int) {
      # Select mapping
      if(p %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03")) {
        triplet_map <- triplet_positions_g1
      } else if(p %in% c("P04", "P05", "P06", "P09")) {
        triplet_map <- triplet_positions_g2
      } else {
        triplet_map <- triplet_positions_g4
      }
      
      # Get intervention DPG data
      dpg_data_int <- ibuttons %>%
        filter(id == p) %>%
        filter(!(p == "P10" & session == "C04_05")) %>%
        group_by(session) %>%
        slice(1) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        mutate(exp_session = as.numeric(gsub("C0[1-4]_", "", session))) %>%
        select(exp_session, DPG_intervention)
      
      # Calculate positions
      pos_dpg_int <- calc_triplet_positions_dpg_int(p, dpg_data_int, triplet_map)
      
      # Extract value
      if(t %in% pos_dpg_int$triplet) {
        if(pos == "pos1") {
          values <- c(values, pos_dpg_int$pos1_dpg_int[pos_dpg_int$triplet == t])
        } else if(pos == "pos2") {
          values <- c(values, pos_dpg_int$pos2_dpg_int[pos_dpg_int$triplet == t])
        } else {
          values <- c(values, pos_dpg_int$pos3_dpg_int[pos_dpg_int$triplet == t])
        }
      }
    }
    
    if(length(values) > 0) {
      n <- length(values)
      mean_triplet_pos_dpg_int_noP07 <- rbind(mean_triplet_pos_dpg_int_noP07, data.frame(
        triplet = t,
        position = pos,
        mean_dpg_int = mean(values, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_dpg_int = sd(values, na.rm = TRUE),
        se_dpg_int = sd(values, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n),
        n_participants = n
      ))
    }
  }
}

# Prepare for plotting
df_plot_positions_triplet_dpg_int_noP07 <- mean_triplet_pos_dpg_int_noP07 %>%
  mutate(
    position_label = case_when(
      position == "pos1" ~ "Position 1",
      position == "pos2" ~ "Position 2",
      position == "pos3" ~ "Position 3"
    ),
    position_num = case_when(
      position == "pos1" ~ 1,
      position == "pos2" ~ 2,
      position == "pos3" ~ 3
    ),
    light_type = case_when(
      position == "pos1" ~ substr(triplet, 1, 1),
      position == "pos2" ~ substr(triplet, 2, 2),
      position == "pos3" ~ substr(triplet, 3, 3)
    ),
    light_label = ifelse(light_type == "D", "dim", "bright")
  ) %>%
  mutate(triplet = factor(triplet, levels = c("DDD", "BDD", "DBD", "BBD", 
                                              "DDB", "BDB", "DBB", "BBB")))
```

# DPG Triplet Time-Course Analysis

## Data Preparation

```{r dpg-triplet-timecourse-setup}
# Get session 3 data for each triplet 
participants_noP07 <- c("P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P09", "P10")
triplets_all <- c("DDD", "DDB", "DBD", "DBB", "BDD", "BDB", "BBD", "BBB")

# Function to get session 3 for each triplet type
get_triplet_session3 <- function(p, triplet_type) {
  if(p %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03")) {
    df_triplets <- df_triplets_g1
  } else if(p %in% c("P04", "P05", "P06", "P09")) {
    df_triplets <- df_triplets_g2
  } else {
    df_triplets <- data.frame(
      session_start = 1:(length(light_g4_orig)-2),
      session_mid = 2:(length(light_g4_orig)-1),
      session_end = 3:length(light_g4_orig),
      triplet = sapply(1:(length(light_g4_orig)-2), function(i) 
        paste0(light_g4_orig[i:(i+2)], collapse = ""))
    ) %>%
      filter(!str_detect(triplet, "X")) %>%
      filter(session_start != 5 & session_mid != 5 & session_end != 5)
  }
  
  sessions_3 <- df_triplets %>%
    filter(triplet == triplet_type) %>%
    pull(session_end)
  
  return(sessions_3)
}

# Function to get all participant-session combinations for a triplet
get_triplet_sessions_overview <- function(triplet_type) {
  overview <- data.frame()
  
  for(p in participants_noP07) {
    sessions_3 <- get_triplet_session3(p, triplet_type)
    
    if(length(sessions_3) > 0) {
      for(s in sessions_3) {
        overview <- rbind(overview, data.frame(
          participant_id = p,
          session = s
        ))
      }
    }
  }
  
  return(overview %>% arrange(session, participant_id))
}

# Function to get group ID from participant ID
get_group_id <- function(p) {
  if(p %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03")) return(1)
  if(p %in% c("P04", "P05")) return(2)
  if(p %in% c("P06", "P07", "P09")) return(3)
  if(p == "P10") return(4)
  return(NA)
}

# Function to create DPG plot for one triplet type
plot_triplet_timecourse_dpg <- function(triplet_type) {
  df_triplet_dpg <- data.frame()
  
  for(p in participants_noP07) {
    sessions_3 <- get_triplet_session3(p, triplet_type)
    
    if(length(sessions_3) > 0) {
      group_id <- get_group_id(p)
      session_ids <- paste0("C0", group_id, "_", sprintf("%02d", sessions_3))
      
      p_data <- ibuttons %>%
        filter(id == p, session %in% session_ids) %>%
        select(id, session, time_block, DPG_30min) %>%
        filter(!is.na(time_block)) %>%
        group_by(session, time_block) %>%
        slice(1) %>%
        ungroup()
      
      df_triplet_dpg <- rbind(df_triplet_dpg, p_data)
    }
  }
  
  if(nrow(df_triplet_dpg) == 0) {
    warning(paste("No data found for triplet", triplet_type))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  df_triplet_dpg <- df_triplet_dpg %>%
    group_by(id, session) %>%
    arrange(time_block) %>%
    mutate(block_num = row_number()) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  triplet_summary <- df_triplet_dpg %>%
    group_by(block_num) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_dpg = mean(DPG_30min, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_dpg = sd(DPG_30min, na.rm = TRUE),
      n = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  y_min <- floor(min(triplet_summary$mean_dpg - triplet_summary$sd_dpg, 
                     na.rm = TRUE) * 10) / 10 - 0.1
  y_max <- ceiling(max(triplet_summary$mean_dpg + triplet_summary$sd_dpg, 
                       na.rm = TRUE) * 10) / 10 + 0.1
  
  third_letter <- substr(triplet_type, 3, 3)
  intervention_color <- ifelse(third_letter == "D", "#F5F5F5", "#FFF9E6")
  intervention_alpha <- ifelse(third_letter == "D", 0.4, 0.8)
  intervention_label <- ifelse(third_letter == "D", "dim\n(10 lx)", "bright\n(1000 lx)")
  
  triplet_first_two <- substr(triplet_type, 1, 2)
  triplet_third <- substr(triplet_type, 3, 3)
  
  p <- ggplot(triplet_summary, aes(x = block_num, y = mean_dpg)) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 0.5, xmax = 6.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
             fill = "#F5F5F5", alpha = 0.4) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 6.5, xmax = 9.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
             fill = intervention_color, alpha = intervention_alpha) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 9.5, xmax = 10.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
             fill = "#F5F5F5", alpha = 0.4) +
    annotate("text", x = 3.5, y = y_max - 0.05, label = "dim\n(10 lx)", 
             hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 3.5, color = "grey50", fontface = "italic") +
    annotate("text", x = 8, y = y_max - 0.05, label = intervention_label, 
             hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 3.5, 
             color = ifelse(third_letter == "D", "grey50", "#B8860B"), 
             fontface = "italic") +
    annotate("text", x = 10, y = y_max - 0.05, label = "dim\n(10 lx)", 
             hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 3.5, color = "grey50", fontface = "italic") +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_dpg - sd_dpg,
                    ymax = mean_dpg + sd_dpg),
                alpha = 0.15, fill = "grey40") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, color = "black") +
    geom_point(size = 3.5, shape = 16, color = "black") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = 1:10,
      labels = c(
        "B1\n(5.25h)", "B2", "B3\n(4.25h)", "B4", "B5\n(3.25h)", 
        "B6", "B7\n(2.25h)", "B8", "B9\n(1.25h)", "B10"
      ),
      limits = c(0.5, 10.5),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(y_min, y_max), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(
      title = bquote("Distal-proximal gradient time course - Triplet " * 
                     .(triplet_first_two) * bold(.(triplet_third))),
      subtitle = paste0("Grand average third-day (n=", 
                       length(unique(df_triplet_dpg$id)), 
                       " participants; P07 excluded)"),
      x = "30-minute block (hours before HBT)",
      y = "Mean distal-proximal gradient (°C)"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      aspect.ratio = 1,
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 10)),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 13),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9, margin = margin(t = 5)),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 12)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 8)),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
      plot.margin = margin(15, 10, 10, 10)
    )
  
  return(p)
}
```

# DPG Triplet Time-Course Summary Table

```{r dpg-triplet-timecourse-summary-table}
# Combine all triplet data for the unified table
triplets_all_list <- c("DDD", "DDB", "DBD", "DBB", "BDD", "BDB", "BBD", "BBB")

df_all_triplets_dpg_unified <- data.frame()

for(triplet_type in triplets_all_list) {
  df_triplet_dpg <- data.frame()
  
  for(p in participants_noP07) {
    sessions_3 <- get_triplet_session3(p, triplet_type)
    
    if(length(sessions_3) > 0) {
      group_id <- get_group_id(p)
      session_ids <- paste0("C0", group_id, "_", sprintf("%02d", sessions_3))
      
      p_data <- ibuttons %>%
        filter(id == p, session %in% session_ids) %>%
        select(id, session, time_block, DPG_30min) %>%
        filter(!is.na(time_block)) %>%
        group_by(session, time_block) %>%
        slice(1) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        mutate(triplet = triplet_type)
      
      df_triplet_dpg <- rbind(df_triplet_dpg, p_data)
    }
  }
  
  # Assign block numbers
  df_triplet_dpg <- df_triplet_dpg %>%
    group_by(id, session) %>%
    arrange(time_block) %>%
    mutate(block_num = row_number()) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  df_all_triplets_dpg_unified <- rbind(df_all_triplets_dpg_unified, df_triplet_dpg)
}

# Calculate summary statistics per triplet and block
triplet_summary_dpg_unified <- df_all_triplets_dpg_unified %>%
  group_by(triplet, block_num) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_dpg = mean(DPG_30min, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dpg = sd(DPG_30min, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(triplet = factor(triplet, levels = triplets_all_list))

# Create table with mean ± SD for all triplets
triplet_timecourse_dpg_table <- triplet_summary_dpg_unified %>%
  mutate(
    mean_sd = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f", mean_dpg, sd_dpg)
  ) %>%
  select(triplet, block_num, mean_sd) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = block_num,
    values_from = mean_sd,
    names_prefix = "B"
  )

knitr::kable(
  triplet_timecourse_dpg_table,
  caption = "Triplet time-course: Mean ± SD distal-proximal gradient (°C) per 30-minute block",
  align = c("l", rep("r", 10))
) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), 
                           full_width = FALSE) %>%
  kableExtra::row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)
```

# DPG Grand Average Time Course

```{r dpg-grand-average-timecourse}
# Map light conditions to each session for DPG (making sure the light patterns are available)
light_patterns_dpg <- list(
  P01 = c("D", "D", "D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"),
  P02 = c("D", "D", "D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"),
  P03 = c("D", "D", "D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"),
  P04 = c("D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"),
  P05 = c("D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"),
  P06 = c("D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"),
  P07 = c("D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"),
  P09 = c("D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B")
)

# Add P10 pattern (12 sessions without session 5)
light_patterns_dpg[["P10"]] <- c("D", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "B", "D", "D")

df_light_dpg <- bind_rows(
  # All participants except P10
  bind_rows(lapply(names(light_patterns_dpg), function(p) {
    pattern <- light_patterns_dpg[[p]]
    data.frame(
      id = p,
      exp_session = seq_along(pattern),
      light = pattern,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })),
  # P10 
  data.frame(
    id = "P10",
    exp_session = 1:13,
    light = ifelse(1:13 %in% c(1,2,3,6,10,12,13), "D", "B"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
)

# Add group information and create session IDs
df_light_dpg <- df_light_dpg %>%
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      id %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03") ~ 1,
      id %in% c("P04", "P05") ~ 2,
      id %in% c("P06", "P07", "P09") ~ 3,
      id == "P10" ~ 4
    ),
    session = paste0("C0", group, "_", sprintf("%02d", exp_session))
  )

# Join with DPG data - get one row per session and time_block
df_dpg_light <- ibuttons %>%
  filter(id %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P09", "P10")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(time_block)) %>%
  group_by(id, session, time_block) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  inner_join(df_light_dpg, by = c("id", "session"))

# Assign block numbers (1-10)
df_dpg_light <- df_dpg_light %>%
  group_by(id, session) %>%
  arrange(time_block) %>%
  mutate(block_num = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

# Calculate per-participant summary
df_summary_dpg_per_participant <- df_dpg_light %>%
  group_by(id, block_num, light) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_dpg = mean(DPG_30min, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dpg = sd(DPG_30min, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    se_dpg = sd_dpg / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(light = factor(light, levels = c("D", "B"), labels = c("Dim", "Bright")))

# Grand average excluding P07
df_summary_dpg_noP07 <- df_summary_dpg_per_participant %>%
  filter(id != "P07")

grand_summary_dpg_manual <- data.frame()

for(b in unique(df_summary_dpg_noP07$block_num)) {
  for(l in levels(df_summary_dpg_noP07$light)) {
    vals <- df_summary_dpg_noP07 %>%
      filter(block_num == b, light == l) %>%
      pull(mean_dpg)
    
    n_val <- length(vals)
    mean_val <- mean(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
    sd_val <- sd(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
    se_val <- sd_val / sqrt(n_val)
    
    grand_summary_dpg_manual <- rbind(grand_summary_dpg_manual, data.frame(
      block_num = b,
      light = l,
      mean_dpg = mean_val,
      sd_dpg = sd_val,
      n = n_val,
      se_dpg = se_val
    ))
  }
}

grand_summary_dpg_manual$light <- factor(grand_summary_dpg_manual$light, 
                                         levels = c("Bright", "Dim"))
```

```{r dpg-grand-average-plot}
# Ensure block_num is numeric
grand_summary_dpg_manual <- grand_summary_dpg_manual %>%
  mutate(block_num = as.numeric(block_num))

# Define labels
hbt_values <- c("5.25", "4.75", "4.25", "3.75", "3.25", "2.75", "2.25", "1.75", "1.25", "0.75")

# Create x-axis labels
x_labels <- sapply(1:10, function(i) {
  if (i %% 2 == 1) {  
    paste0("B", i, "\n(", hbt_values[i], "h)")
  } else {  
    paste0("B", i)
  }
})

# Y-axis limits
y_min <- floor(min(grand_summary_dpg_manual$mean_dpg - grand_summary_dpg_manual$se_dpg, 
                   na.rm = TRUE) * 10) / 10 - 0.1
y_max <- ceiling(max(grand_summary_dpg_manual$mean_dpg + grand_summary_dpg_manual$se_dpg, 
                     na.rm = TRUE) * 10) / 10 + 0.1

# Create plot
ggplot(grand_summary_dpg_manual, 
       aes(x = block_num, y = mean_dpg, 
           color = light, fill = light, group = light)) +
  # Background shading
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0.5, xmax = 6.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
           fill = "#F5F5F5", alpha = 0.4) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 6.5, xmax = 9.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
           fill = "#FFF9E6", alpha = 0.8) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 9.5, xmax = 10.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
           fill = "#F5F5F5", alpha = 0.4) +
  annotate("text", x = 3.75, y = y_max - 0.05, label = "dim\n(10 lx)",  
           hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 3.5, color = "grey50", fontface = "italic") +
  annotate("text", x = 8, y = y_max - 0.05, label = "intervention\n(10 or 1000 lx)",  
           hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 3.5, color = "#B8860B", fontface = "italic") +
  annotate("text", x = 10, y = y_max - 0.05, label = "dim\n(10 lx)", 
           hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 3.5, color = "grey50", fontface = "italic") + 
  # Ribbon for SE
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_dpg - se_dpg,
                  ymax = mean_dpg + se_dpg),
              alpha = 0.1, color = NA, show.legend = FALSE) +
  # Line and points
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5, shape = 16) +
  # Colors
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Bright" = "#F5A623", "Dim" = "#4A90E2"),
    labels = c("Bright" = "Bright (1000 lx)", "Dim" = "Dim (10 lx)")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Bright" = "#F5A623", "Dim" = "#4A90E2"),
    labels = c("Bright" = "Bright (1000 lx)", "Dim" = "Dim (10 lx)")
  ) +
  # Axes 
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 1:10,
    labels = x_labels,
    limits = c(0.5, 10.5),

  ) +

  # Labels
  labs(

    subtitle = "Grand average across participants (P07 excluded, n=8)",
    x = "30-minute block (hours before HBT)",
    y = "Mean Distal-Proximal Gradient (°C)",
    color = "Light condition",
    fill = "Light condition"
  ) +
  # Theme
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
```

# DPG Panel View - Triplet and Grand Average Time Courses

```{r dpg-panel-view-setup}
#| label: fig-dpg-triplet-panel
#| fig-cap: "Distal-proximal gradient time course - Grand average and triplet patterns (P07 excluded)"
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 8

# 1. Prepare data for all triplets
triplets_all_panel <- c("DDD", "BDD", "DBD", "BBD", "DDB", "BDB", "DBB", "BBB")

df_all_triplets_dpg_for_panel <- data.frame()

for(triplet_type in triplets_all_panel) {
  df_triplet_dpg <- data.frame()
  
  for(p in participants_noP07) {
    sessions_3 <- get_triplet_session3(p, triplet_type)
    
    if(length(sessions_3) > 0) {
      group_id <- get_group_id(p)
      session_ids <- paste0("C0", group_id, "_", sprintf("%02d", sessions_3))
      
      p_data <- ibuttons %>%
        filter(id == p, session %in% session_ids) %>%
        select(id, session, time_block, DPG_30min) %>%
        filter(!is.na(time_block)) %>%
        group_by(session, time_block) %>%
        slice(1) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        mutate(triplet = triplet_type)
      
      df_triplet_dpg <- rbind(df_triplet_dpg, p_data)
    }
  }
  
  df_triplet_dpg <- df_triplet_dpg %>%
    group_by(id, session) %>%
    arrange(time_block) %>%
    mutate(block_num = row_number()) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  df_all_triplets_dpg_for_panel <- rbind(df_all_triplets_dpg_for_panel, df_triplet_dpg)
}

# 2. Calculate summary per triplet
triplet_summary_dpg_for_panel <- df_all_triplets_dpg_for_panel %>%
  group_by(triplet, block_num) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_dpg = mean(DPG_30min, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dpg = sd(DPG_30min, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    triplet = factor(triplet, levels = triplets_all_panel),
    triplet_type = ifelse(substr(triplet, 3, 3) == "D", "Dim", "Bright")
  )

# 3. Unified Y-axis limits
y_min_dpg_unified <- floor(min(triplet_summary_dpg_for_panel$mean_dpg - triplet_summary_dpg_for_panel$sd_dpg, 
                               na.rm = TRUE) * 10) / 10 - 0.1
y_max_dpg_unified <- ceiling(max(triplet_summary_dpg_for_panel$mean_dpg + triplet_summary_dpg_for_panel$sd_dpg, 
                                 na.rm = TRUE) * 10) / 10 + 0.1

# 4. Function to create triplet plot
create_triplet_plot_dpg <- function(triplet_name, show_x = FALSE, show_y = TRUE) {
  data_triplet <- triplet_summary_dpg_for_panel %>%
    filter(triplet == triplet_name)
  
  triplet_third <- substr(triplet_name, 3, 3)
  intervention_color <- ifelse(triplet_third == "D", "#F5F5F5", "#FFF9E6")
  intervention_alpha <- ifelse(triplet_third == "D", 0.4, 0.8)
  
  triplet_first_two <- substr(triplet_name, 1, 2)
  triplet_label <- paste0(triplet_first_two, "**", triplet_third, "**")
  
  x_labels_with_hbt <- c(
    "B1\n(5.25h)", "B2", "B3\n(4.25h)", "B4", "B5\n(3.25h)", 
    "B6", "B7\n(2.25h)", "B8", "B9\n(1.25h)", "B10"
  )
  
  ggplot(data_triplet, aes(x = block_num, y = mean_dpg)) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 0.5, xmax = 6.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
             fill = "#F5F5F5", alpha = 0.4) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 6.5, xmax = 9.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
             fill = intervention_color, alpha = intervention_alpha) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 9.5, xmax = 10.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
             fill = "#F5F5F5", alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_dpg - sd_dpg, 
                    ymax = mean_dpg + sd_dpg),
                alpha = 0.15, fill = "grey40") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, color = "black") +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, shape = 16, color = "black") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = 1:10,
      labels = if(show_x) x_labels_with_hbt else 1:10,
      limits = c(0.5, 10.5),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(y_min_dpg_unified, y_max_dpg_unified), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(
      title = triplet_label,
      x = NULL,
      y = if(show_y) "Mean DPG ± SD (°C)" else NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_markdown(size = 11, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 5)),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 9),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = if(show_x) 7 else 8, margin = margin(t = 3)),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 5)),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
      plot.margin = margin(5, 5, if(show_x) 8 else 5, 5)
    )
}

# 5. Create D-ending triplet plots (no x-axis labels)
p_DDD_dpg <- create_triplet_plot_dpg("DDD", show_x = FALSE, show_y = TRUE)
p_BDD_dpg <- create_triplet_plot_dpg("BDD", show_x = FALSE, show_y = FALSE)
p_DBD_dpg <- create_triplet_plot_dpg("DBD", show_x = FALSE, show_y = FALSE)
p_BBD_dpg <- create_triplet_plot_dpg("BBD", show_x = FALSE, show_y = FALSE)

# 6. Create B-ending triplet plots (with x-axis labels)

p_BDB_dpg <- create_triplet_plot_dpg("BDB", show_x = TRUE, show_y = FALSE)
p_DBB_dpg <- create_triplet_plot_dpg("DBB", show_x = TRUE, show_y = FALSE)

# 7. Grand Average plot
p_grand_dpg <- ggplot(grand_summary_dpg_manual,

  annotate("rect", xmin = 9.5, xmax = 10.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,

  annotate("rect", xmin = 6.5, xmax = 9.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "#FFF9E6", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_dpg - se_dpg,
                  ymax = mean_dpg + se_dpg),
              alpha = 0.1, color = NA, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, shape = 16) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Bright" = "#F5A623", "Dim" = "#4A90E2"),
    labels = c("Bright" = "Bright (1000lx)", "Dim" = "Dim (10lx)")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Bright" = "#F5A623", "Dim" = "#4A90E2"),
    labels = c("Bright" = "Bright (1000lx)", "Dim" = "Dim (10lx)")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 1:10,
    labels = 1:10,
    limits = c(0.5, 10.5),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(y_min_dpg_unified, y_max_dpg_unified), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    title = "Grand Average",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    color = "Light condition"
  ) +
  guides(

  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 5)),

# 8. Empty spacer
p_spacer_dpg <- ggplot() + theme_void()

# 9. Combine in layout
(p_DDD_dpg | p_BDD_dpg | p_DBD_dpg | p_BBD_dpg | p_grand_dpg) /
(p_DDB_dpg | p_BDB_dpg | p_DBB_dpg | p_BBB_dpg | p_spacer_dpg) +
```

# Data Preparation for DPG Statistical Analysis

## Define Study Parameters for DPG

```{r dpg-lmm-setup}
# Define participant list and light patterns
participant_list_dpg <- c("P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P09", "P10")

# Light patterns for DPG (making sure light patterns are available)
light_patterns_dpg <- list(
  P01 = c("D", "D", "D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"),
  P02 = c("D", "D", "D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"),
  P03 = c("D", "D", "D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"),
  P04 = c("D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"),
  P05 = c("D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"),
  P06 = c("D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"),
  P07 = c("D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"),
  P09 = c("D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B")
)

# Combine DPG data with light information
ibuttons_lmm <- map_dfr(participant_list_dpg, ~{
  df <- ibuttons %>% 
    filter(id == .x) %>%
    # Extract session number from session variable (e.g., "C01_01" -> 1, "C01_02" -> 2)
    mutate(exp_session = as.integer(gsub("C0[1-4]_", "", session))) %>%
    # Keep only DPG_intervention values (one per session)
    filter(!is.na(DPG_intervention)) %>%
    distinct(id, exp_session, DPG_intervention, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    select(id, exp_session, DPG_intervention) %>%
    rename(participant_id = id)
  
  # Special light pattern assignment for P10 (light automation malfunction session 5)
  if(.x == "P10") {
    # Manual assignment for each actual session number
    light_df <- tibble(
      exp_session = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13),
      Light_Lag0 = c("D", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "B", "D", "D")
    )
  } else {
    light_df <- tibble(
      exp_session = seq_along(light_patterns_dpg[[.x]]),
      Light_Lag0 = light_patterns_dpg[[.x]]
    )
  }
  
  df <- df %>% 
    left_join(light_df, by = "exp_session")
  
  return(df)
})

# Build lagged light variables and filter valid triplets
ibuttons_lmm <- ibuttons_lmm %>%
  group_by(participant_id) %>%
  arrange(exp_session) %>%
  mutate(
    Light_Lag1 = lag(Light_Lag0, 1),
    Light_Lag2 = lag(Light_Lag0, 2)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(Light_Lag0) & !is.na(Light_Lag1) & !is.na(Light_Lag2)) %>%
  filter(!(participant_id == "P10" & exp_session %in% c(6, 7))) %>%
  mutate(
    Light_Lag0_num = ifelse(Light_Lag0 == "D", 0, 1),
    Light_Lag1_num = ifelse(Light_Lag1 == "D", 0, 1),
    Light_Lag2_num = ifelse(Light_Lag2 == "D", 0, 1)
  )

# Add participant demographics
participant_demographics_dpg <- tibble(
  participant_id = c("P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P09", "P10"),
  sex = c("female", "male", "female", "female", "male", "female", "female", "female", "male"),
  age = c(24, 21, 24, 23, 31, 23, 24, 28, 32),
  bmi = c(25.82645, 18.83239, 28.01022, 24.67550, 20.28651, 22.23099, 23.23346, 24.50895, 27.14304)
)

ibuttons_lmm <- ibuttons_lmm %>%
  left_join(participant_demographics_dpg, by = "participant_id")

# Apply exclusion criteria
ibuttons_lmm <- ibuttons_lmm %>%
  filter(participant_id != "P07")  # Exclude P07

# Keep only necessary variables
ibuttons_lmm <- ibuttons_lmm %>%
  dplyr::select(
    participant_id, exp_session, DPG_intervention,
    Light_Lag0, Light_Lag1, Light_Lag2,
    Light_Lag0_num, Light_Lag1_num, Light_Lag2_num,
    sex, age, bmi
  )
```

Interpretation: Despite the light left-skewness of the raw data, a LMM with Gaussian identity link function will be applied. However, within the diagnostics checks the normality assumption for residuals will be evaluated and different sensitivity analyses applied if necessary.

## DPG Trajectories Across Experimental Sessions

Individual participant trajectories with LOESS smooth (full dataset, n=67 observations)

```{r dpg-lmm-trajectories}
# Prepare data - count observations per session
session_counts_dpg <- ibuttons_lmm %>%
  group_by(exp_session) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Create plot
ggplot(ibuttons_lmm, 
       aes(x = exp_session, y = DPG_intervention, 
           color = participant_id, group = participant_id)) +
  
  # Individual trajectories
  geom_line(alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  
  # LOESS smooth (overall trend)
  geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "loess", span = 0.75,
              color = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1.2,
              se = TRUE, fill = "grey50", alpha = 0.3) +
  
  # Add sample size annotations for reduced sessions
  geom_text(data = session_counts_dpg %>% filter(n < 8),
            aes(x = exp_session, y = max(ibuttons_lmm$DPG_intervention) * 0.998, 
                label = paste0("n=", n)),
            color = "black", size = 3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  
  # Vertical line for data cutoff (session 10)
  geom_vline(xintercept = 10.5, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.8) +
  
  # Scales
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 3:13,
    limits = c(2.5, 13.5),
    expand = c(0.01, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05))
  ) +
  
  # Colors
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("P01" = "#E41A1C", "P02" = "#377EB8", "P03" = "#4DAF4A",
               "P04" = "#984EA3", "P05" = "#FF7F00", "P06" = "#FFFF33",
               "P09" = "#A65628", "P10" = "#F781BF"),
    name = "Participant"
  ) +
  
  # Labels
  labs(
    title = "Distal-proximal gradient across experimental sessions",
    subtitle = "Individual participant trajectories with LOESS smooth (full dataset, n=67, P07 excluded)",
    x = "Experimental Session",
    y = "Distal-Proximal Gradient (°C)"
  ) +
  
  # Theme
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "plain"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, margin = margin(b = 10)),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
    plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 10, 10)
  )
```
